summary: Pinned the producer scope behind the one asserted defect so the claim no longer depends on prose in an interpretation. A search of non-test code for construction of the cluster summary type finds exactly three sites, all in node.go: node.notifyConfigChange, which fills the record from the membership and sets the witness flag before storing it; the pending branch of node.getClusterInfo, which builds a value when no record exists; and the ordinary rebuild in the same function, which copies the stored fields and recomputes the leader flag and state machine type. Only the first sets the witness flag, and both caller-visible branches leave it false, so there is no alternate producer that could restore it on a different path. That boundary is now recorded as a citable Fact; no execution, conclusion or gap changed, and the audit's questions all remain closed with the witness-reporting defect as its single asserted finding.
